prompts.scene-01:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: standalone widescreen cinematic anime story illustration for an immersive website. This is artwork, never a page screenshot.
Style: cohesive polished original anime cel shading, fine dark linework, detailed atmospheric Japanese rural mountain environments, moody icy-blue winter light contrasted with warm amber. Original homage artwork, do not reproduce an existing anime frame.
Composition: landscape 16:9, high resolution around 1792x1024 or 1536x1024 if supported. ALL important faces fairly large for facial rigging, at least 140 pixels across in final image; main faces located in the upper half and inside the inner 10% margins. The shoulders and story actions occupy the lower half. Clear separated facial silhouettes, unobstructed eyes, readable expressions. Avoid excessive distant full-body characters, use cinematic waist-up medium composition with environment around them.
Tanjiro invariant: recognizable Tanjiro Kamado, burgundy swept spiky hair, red-brown eyes, forehead scar, hanafuda earrings, green-and-black checkered haori over dark clothing.
Nezuko invariant: recognizable Nezuko Kamado, long black hair with warm orange tips, pink ribbon, pale skin, pink patterned kimono and dark-brown haori. Human Nezuko has natural human eyes; demon Nezuko has large pink eyes.
Constraints: no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark, no gore, no blood. Faces cannot touch image edges. Detailed faces and clear irises.
Scene: Before tragedy, Tanjiro ready to sell charcoal at his snowy mountain home's doorstep at sunrise. Mother Kie has a warm smile and sees him off; human Nezuko helps with the charcoal basket. Convey intimate family warmth.
Character layout: main mother Kie face in left upper half, Tanjiro main face in right upper half, both large and prominent with faces around 180-250px wide. Human Nezuko smaller in the middle behind them, face still 140px or wider. Mother Kie wears a modest pale traditional kimono, dark hair pinned back, gentle maternal expression. Tanjiro holds or adjusts a basket filled with charcoal in the lower half, ready to depart. Nezuko's helping hands visible near the basket. All three faces unobstructed.
Environment: rural wooden Japanese home doorway behind, snow on roof and ground, distant cedars, soft golden sunrise contrasting icy-blue snow. Use gentle happy expressions, no demon traits or bamboo muzzle on Nezuko in this scene.
